cases.title: Fresh empty startup
preconditions: Start with no persisted session data loaded.
expected: No sample chart is generated.
The empty state and primary action are readable.

cases.title: Prague ExactTime in Obsidian
actions: Enter the fixture through real controls.
expected: The wheel fits the viewport.
Golden numerical evidence remains owned by the Prague fixture tests.
Chart annotations and shell controls remain readable.

cases.title: Prague ExactTime in Porcelain
actions: Enter the fixture through real controls.
expected: The wheel fits the viewport.
Golden numerical evidence remains owned by the Prague fixture tests.
Porcelain shell and chart are visually coherent.

cases.title: Prague UnknownTime
preconditions: The Prague date and place are available.
actions: Select UnknownTime in the real ComboBox.
expected: The disabled time editor shows no active value.
Houses and principal angles are absent.
Aries-at-top and noon-fallback numerical contracts remain test-owned.

cases.title: Live theme switching
actions: Open a ComboBox in each theme.
expected: All shell and chart resources update.
No red or salmon platform accent appears.
No duplicate-resource or popup error occurs.

cases.title: Live language switching
actions: Switch UI language from Russian to English.
expected: Visible labels update without restarting.
Layout remains readable in both languages.
Chart numerical data is unchanged.

cases.title: Responsive chart and columns
preconditions: The Prague ExactTime chart is visible.
actions: Resize continuously from standard to compact.
expected: The complete wheel remains fitted.
No clipping or overlapping scroll owners appear.
Controls remain operable.

cases.title: ExactTime value restoration
expected: UnknownTime visually hides the value and disables the editor.
ExactTime restores 13:45 within the session.

cases.title: Birth-data validation error
actions: Enter invalid latitude through the editor.
expected: Error text and border use semantic error treatment.
Focus remains visible.
No chart is generated from invalid data.

cases.title: Settings theme ComboBox popup
expected: Default, hover, selected, and focus states are distinct.
No platform red or salmon accent leaks.
The selection changes the application theme.

cases.title: Tarot three-card spread in Obsidian with Black Sun
preconditions: Open Tarot in Obsidian with expanded navigation.
actions: Confirm the Толкование selector contains and selects exactly one Классика item.
Select Three cards and Black Sun.
Enable reversed cards and automatic reveal.
Scroll the unified reading surface and select cards with pointer and keyboard.
expected: Three equal 315 by 540 DIP 7:12 raster cards form one readable row at maximized width.
Cards reveal immediately; reversal, selection, and focus remain legible.
Controls stay fixed while the reading surface scrolls; no placeholder, diagnostic, empty bordered interpretation block, inspector, or visible tableau/interpretation heading appears.

cases.title: Tarot three-card spread in Porcelain with Lunar Seal
actions: Confirm the Interpretation selector contains and selects exactly one Classic item.
Select Three cards and Lunar Seal.
Disable automatic reveal and draw through the real button.
Confirm all backs and no interpretation UI, then reveal one card through a real control.
expected: Porcelain surfaces retain semantic contrast without platform red/salmon.
Lunar Seal differs visibly from Black Sun and cards remain aligned.
Only the activated card reveals; the other backs remain hidden and the interpretation host remains completely silent.

cases.title: Tarot single card in the unified reading surface
actions: Select Single card and enable automatic reveal.
Select the card with Enter or Space.
expected: The 378 by 648 DIP raster card is centered and already revealed.
The all-not-ready Classic skeleton produces no heading, placeholder, diagnostic, empty bordered block, metadata inspector, or reserved lower panel.

cases.title: Tarot compact collapsed three-card workspace
actions: Resize below the shell compact threshold.
Resize continuously and use tableau scrolling if required.
Return to Astrology and reopen Tarot.
expected: No shell-level horizontal clipping appears.
Cards retain 7:12 and never shrink below 216 DIP.
The tableau owns horizontal scrolling, the unified reading surface owns vertical scrolling and mouse-wheel movement, and the fixed controls do not scroll.
Workspace preferences survive section changes.

cases.title: Tarot preferences persist without restoring a reading
preconditions: Launch Debug with an injected temporary AppData root and no settings file.
actions: Seed schema 1 and confirm launch does not rewrite it.
Change one listed preference through a real control and confirm schema 2 contains selectedInterpretationPackId classic.
Close only that process and launch a fresh process with the same temporary AppData root.
Open Tarot, then repeat with an unknown schema-2 pack ID.
expected: The selected spread, Classic interpretation pack, back, reversal policy, and automatic-reveal value are restored or silently normalized.
Schema 1 bytes remain unchanged until a real preference change; the next save is schema 2 and preserves other values.
No current reading, revealed position, selection, interpretation content, resolved locale, or scroll offset is restored.
